title: Ensemble machine learning estimated rheumatoid-arthritis flare risk during biologic tapering
summary: An ensemble model estimated individual flare risk among rheumatoid-arthritis patients tapering biologic drugs, using trial follow-up data. This retrospective prediction analysis does not show that model-guided tapering improves outcomes.
ai_technology: Ensemble machine-learning model for individual rheumatoid-arthritis flare risk.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Trial follow-up data were used to predict flare during biologic-drug tapering.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective prediction; no prospective model-guided treatment benefit established.
